science.title: Open-access tool decodes DNA change patterns in breast cancer
science.description: A study led by Dr. Jason Pitt, Principal Investigator at the Cancer Science Institute of Singapore (CSI Singapore), has identified eight new "signatures" of DNA patterns (gains and/or losses) in breast cancer. By analyzing nearly 2,800 genomes, the team systematically profiled changes in the number of DNA copies in breast cancer, with the goal of better understanding the underlying mechanisms of tumor development and evaluating how these structural genomic changes relate to clinical outcomes.
